title: 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE---: what a change of stage hands on
text: When a carry leaves the last word R of 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE---, the head runs to the blank after R and comes back in state C through every item. The phases of the chain law at that moment say what this return does: each 11 and 01 moves 2 cells right or left, and every word is rewritten as 0 or 2 with carries. In 150 stages, all 116 changes of stage the rule covers match it cell by cell (py/stage_change.py); 70 others, mostly at empty words, are set apart.
